name: Chichigami Kana
source:
The younger twin sister. Prone to illness since childhood, she has not been attending school. Instead, her mother Manami teaches her everything which includes her academic studies.

She loves books and has read countless books in her library, she wants to read all the books in her family's library.

Kana has a calm personality and enjoys going at her own pace. She is not good at talking to people outside her family and is extremely shy. This is even more apparent towards men. However, once she gets to know you, she opens up more than anyone else.

Nipple size: XL(6.3cm)
Areola color: Peach blossom pink
